name: Shaky Hands
body:
Prerequisites: Disable Device or Sleight of Hand as class skill.

Bane: You suffer a -2 penalty to Disable Device and Sleight of Hand checks and cannot take 10 with such skills. Additionally whenever you roll a natural 1 or 2 (the die shows a “1`” or “2”) on an attack rolls, skill check, or Reflex save, you drop all held items.
